heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: What is BSC Finance at ATLAS ISME?
a: B.Sc. Finance at ATLAS ISME is a 4-year undergraduate program that provides a robust foundation in financial principles, preparing students for diverse careers in the global economy. This comprehensive program provides you with the essential financial knowledge and analytical skills.

Students will be taught by leading experts in the field, including both academics and industry professionals. Our graduates are equipped for successful careers in investment banking, trading, sales, investment management, management consulting, start-ups, research and academia.
ATLAS ISME's B.Sc. Finance program equips you with the industry-demand skills and expertise to excel in the financial domain through:

items: for a dynamic business and finance world.
to gain insights into global financial systems.
through industry visits, case studies and interactions with finance leaders.
integrating technology to navigate the evolving finance industry.

items.q: What is the eligibility for the B.Sc. Finance program at ATLAS?
a: Students must have 50% or above in 12th grade from CBSE/ISC/State Boards with Mathematics as a mandatory subject. IB Diploma holders need a minimum of 24 points and A-Level students must have A/B/C in two subjects, including Grade B or above in Maths.

items.q: How does this B.Sc. Finance program at ATLAS ISME prepares students for global finance careers across markets?
a: The program prepares students for global finance careers through a blend of conceptual knowledge and practical application.

items: Understanding of financial markets and investment strategies
Exposure to quantitative and analytical tools
Experience through case studies and industry projects
Insights into global financial systems and trends

items.q: How are fintech, digital banking and innovation embedded in the curriculum?
a: The curriculum of our program is designed quite meticulously. We aim to cover all topics which are related to finance. Students learn through:

items: Modules covering financial technologies and evolving banking systems
Exposure to regulatory, taxation and financial frameworks
Case-based learning on modern financial challenges

items.q: What kind of internships or externships are offered during the program?
a: We believe in shaping and preparing the students for the outside world by offering them internships and externships during the program. We always focus on experiential learning, which allows students to bridge the gap between classroom learning and real-world finance challenges.

items.q: How are students exposed to real-world financial modelling and analytics challenges?
a: Our approach to studies has never been conventional. We believe in traditional teaching methods as well as modern techniques and with a balanced approach, we allow students to grasp financial concepts through global learning and industry immersions. Discussion, debates and entrepreneurial thinking help students widen their scope of understanding and grapple with real-world financial problems effortlessly.

items.q: How does the program support global immersion, study tours or exchange opportunities?
a: The program is designed to support global immersion study tours or exchange opportunities by collaborating with international universities and partnering with global institutions. The study tours help students to engage with individuals from different cultural backgrounds, leading to academic enrichment and cultural immersion.

items.q: Is the B.Sc. Finance curriculum aligned with the CFA Program and does it help in CFA preparation?
a: Yes, B.Sc.Finance curriculum at ATLAS ISME is aligned with the globally recognised CFA Program.

While the program aligns with CFA Level concepts, students are also supported with resources to help prepare for the CFA exams. And, through the B.Sc. Finance curriculum offered at ATLAS ISME, students can expect industry-relevant knowledge and skills needed for success in the financial industry.

items.q: Does ATLAS ISME provide CAT and CFA exam coaching on campus?
a: Yes, ATLAS ISME provides students with CAT and CFA exam coaching on campus. The modules of our course are designed so that students are coached for CAT & CFA exams. With case studies and industry notes, we ensure students have in-depth knowledge and are well-prepared for the exam.

items.q: How does direct industry teaching from CXOs and founders benefit B.Sc. Finance students at ATLAS ISME?
a: At ATLAS ISME, B.Sc. Finance students learn directly from CXOs, founders and industry leaders through guest lectures, masterclasses and live business case discussions. Unlike traditional theory-based learning, this hands-on approach brings real-world financial insights, current market trends and practical skills into the classroom.
Students gain exposure to leadership strategies, financial tools and real-time decision-making, preparing them for the fast-paced finance industry with greater confidence and job readiness.

items.q: Can students align their coursework with professional certifications?
a: Yes, students can align their coursework with professional certifications. The institution offers certifications such as FinTech & AI Investing (LIBF), which prepares students for digital finance; Portfolio & Wealth Management (NISM), which builds expertise in managing investments and financial portfolios; and Mutual Fund & Financial Services (NISM), which provides a foundation in financial advisory and investment strategy.
These certifications help students build confidence, gain deeper knowledge and understanding and improve their readiness for job opportunities.
